description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer codec for well-known StringComparer types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes classes for serializing and deserializing StringComparer instances, as well as related codecs for EqualityComparer and Comparer types.

classes.name: WellKnownStringComparerCodec
classes.description: Serializer for well-known StringComparer types, supporting serialization and deserialization of StringComparer instances with culture and case options.

classes.name: EqualityComparerBaseCodec`1
classes.description: Codec for serializing and copying EqualityComparer instances.

classes.name: ComparerBaseCodec`1
classes.description: Codec for serializing and copying Comparer instances.

methods.name: WellKnownStringComparerCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal comparer and type references.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported by this codec.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a StringComparer instance from the wire format.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a StringComparer instance into the wire format.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownCultureAwareComparerInfo
methods.description: Attempts to extract culture-aware comparer info from a serializable object (only in non-.NET 6+).

methods.name: ThrowNotSupported
methods.description: Throws exception for unsupported values or types.
